item.title: PKY-60W Standard Irrigation Control System | PKYDrip
item.description: In farm and commercial irrigation, PKY-60W is often deployed not as a standalone device, but as the control core of a complete irrigation control system: coordinating pump and valve control, managing multi-zone operation, and interfacing with optional sensors and expansion modules.

item.title: PKYDrip Wired Main Controller – PKY-60W
item.description:
Role in the Irrigation System

PKY-60W is a wired main controller.
